app_info.subtitle: Manage mittwald hosting
app_info.description: Manage your mittwald (mStudio) hosting infrastructure from ChatGPT. List and inspect projects, apps, servers and domains; provision and manage MySQL and Redis databases, users, backups and backup schedules; work with containers, stacks, cron jobs and volumes; configure domains, DNS zones, virtual hosts, SSL certificates and mail addresses; manage organization and project members, SSH users and keys, and API tokens. Read-only tools inspect resources, while write tools create, update or remove them on the authenticated user's behalf.

test_cases.description: List the projects available to the authenticated user.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me all my mittwald projects.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the list of projects the user can access with enough detail to pick one for follow-up actions.

test_cases.description: List the apps installed in a specific project.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which apps are installed in my project p-abc123?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the apps installed in the given project, including names and versions.

test_cases.description: Inspect available upgrades for an app before acting.
test_cases.user_prompt: Are there any available upgrades for the app a-xyz789?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the versions the app installation could be upgraded to, without changing anything.

test_cases.description: Create a new MySQL database in a project.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a MySQL database in project p-abc123 with description "staging db".
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the database and returns its identifier and connection metadata.

test_cases.description: Resolve SSH connection details for an app without opening a session.
test_cases.user_prompt: How do I SSH into the app a-xyz789?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the SSH host, user, directory and a ready-to-run ssh command for the user to execute locally.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated general knowledge questions.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is the capital of France?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is unrelated to mittwald hosting management.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for hosting providers other than mittwald.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Deploy my app to AWS Elastic Beanstalk.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it only manages mittwald (mStudio) infrastructure.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not open interactive sessions or run remote commands on the server.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Open a live SSH shell to my server and run top for 5 minutes.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked to run an interactive session; at most it returns connection details for the user to run locally, and no tool performs a live remote shell.
